seo.description: Cotton towels, bathrobes and hotel linen for importers in the US, Canada and Australia. Woven at our partner mill in Solapur since 1972. Samples first.

hero.headline: Cotton Towels, Bathrobes & Hotel Linen for Importers Worldwide
hero.subtitle: We supply importers, distributors and private-label brands — not end users. Your specification, approved on a physical sample before bulk, shipped FOB with full documentation.

brandIntro.heading: Fifty-four years of weaving behind every order
brandIntro.copy1: Kiran Global Exports is the appointed marketing and export partner of V P Mundada, a terry mill that has been weaving in Solapur, Maharashtra since 1972. We connect importers and distributors worldwide with the mill's cotton towels, bathrobes, bath mats and hotel linen.
brandIntro.copy2: That matters for a practical reason. Weaving, dyeing and finishing terry consistently is not something a factory learns quickly, and the difference shows up in your second order, not your first. When you reorder from us, you are reordering from the same looms.
brandIntro.copy3: We work from Jaipur and handle your specification, sampling and order coordination. Your contract and shipment are direct with the mill — you are dealing with the people who actually weave your towels, and with a fifty-four-year-old weaver on the other side of the table.

featuredProducts.title: Featured Towels
featuredProducts.lead: A selection from our towel range, chosen for hospitality, retail, spa and private-label buyers.

points.title: Your specification, not our catalogue
points.body: GSM, size, colour, border, hem, label and packaging are set by you. Nothing goes to bulk until you have held a physical sample and approved it.

points.title: Cotton traceability documentation
points.body: We hold the documentation importers need for forced-labour due diligence. For shipments into the United States this is a customs matter, not a preference.

points.title: Repeat production that matches
points.body: Colour is approved by lab dip before bulk dyeing, and every batch is checked against the approved sample — so your second order looks like your first.

points.title: Direct mill terms
points.body: Quotations and shipment come directly from the mill on FOB terms. You keep control of freight and your own landed cost, and your commercial relationship is with the manufacturer itself.

points.title: Samples before commitment
points.body: Sample lead time confirmed per order. No minimum order for samples.

seo.title: About
seo.description: Kiran Global Exports develops premium towel and rug collections in India for hospitality, retail and private-label buyers worldwide.

intro.title: Where craft meets comfort.
intro.lead: Kiran Global Exports connects Indian textile craftsmanship with buyers around the world, developing premium towel and rug collections built around quality, consistency and presentation.

brandStory.heading: Developed around the buyer, not the shelf.
brandStory.copy1: Every collection begins with a specification, not a catalogue page. We work directly with hospitality groups, distributors, retailers and private-label buyers to develop towels and rugs suited to their market — from fibre selection through to final packing.
brandStory.copy2: Our approach favours consistency over volume: dependable specifications, repeatable production, and direct communication with an export team that understands international buyer requirements.

pillars.title: Understand the market
pillars.body: We start with the buyer's market — hospitality, spa, retail or private label — and the standards it demands.

pillars.title: Develop to specification
pillars.body: Material, GSM, size, colour and construction are developed to match, not adapted after the fact.

pillars.title: Produce with consistency
pillars.body: Quality control at every stage keeps repeat orders matching the original approval.

pillars.title: Coordinate the shipment
pillars.body: Packing, documentation and logistics coordinated around the buyer's destination market.

partner.title: Mundada Towels — fifty-four years of textile expertise.
partner.lead: Kiran Global Exports works in partnership with Mundada Towels, a trusted manufacturer and exporter of premium terry towels established in 1972 in Solapur, Maharashtra. Together, we serve international B2B buyers with dependable towel solutions built around their specifications, quality requirements and market needs.
partner.copy1: With fifty-four years of textile expertise, Mundada Towels combines traditional craftsmanship with modern manufacturing, strict quality control and ongoing product development. This manufacturing strength supports Kiran Global Exports in delivering consistent, specification-led towel programs for global buyers.
partner.copy2: The range includes bath, hand, face, pool, beach, kitchen and institutional towels, alongside jacquard, zero-twist, vat-dyed, bamboo, recycled-yarn and customized towel programs.
partner.copy3: Certifications including OEKO-TEX®, GRS, ISO 9001, MADE IN GREEN and BSCI support a strong focus on quality, sustainability and responsible manufacturing.

rugSection.title: Rugs supplied around your business requirements.
rugSection.lead: Alongside our towel business, Kiran Global Exports works directly with B2B buyers for rugs. We source and develop products around the buyer's design, dimensions, materials, construction, colours, quantities, packaging and commercial specifications.
rugSection.copy: From hospitality and interior projects to retail, wholesale and private-label programs, our focus is simple: understand the requirement, develop the right product and coordinate reliable supply for the agreed specification.

privacy.intro: This page is a professional starting framework. The company owner and legal adviser must confirm the final policy before publication.

sections.heading: Information received through enquiries
sections.body: The website may receive information submitted through the enquiry form, such as name, company, country, email, phone or WhatsApp, product interest, quantity and message. Confirm the final collection, retention and access process before launch.

sections.heading: How information may be used

sections.heading: Storage and service providers

sections.heading: Contact and rights
